data.long_meaning: The name Yashpal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Yas’ (God) and ‘Pal’ (treasure). This name is a tribute to the belief that the true wealth lies in the blessings of the divine. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is often referred to as the protector and preserver of all treasures. The name Yashpal carries the meaning “God's treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Yashpal usually hope their child will grow to embody god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashpal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yashpal reflects a strong attachment to the Hindu faith and its values. In Hindu culture, the name is symbolic of the importance of seeking blessings from the gods and regarding them as the greatest source of wealth and prosperity. It signifies the desire to lead a virtuous life filled with spiritual growth and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Yashpal revolves around the idea of divine blessings and the belief that the protection and grace of the gods are essential for success and happiness in life. It is a reminder to place faith in the divine and acknowledge the presence and power of the gods in all aspects of life. The name also signifies a lifelong quest for spiritual growth and enlightenment, as one strives to be a treasure to the divine and to others through acts of kindness and generosity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yashpal: One who embodies righteousness and brings glory to God through their actions. The name Yash signifies fame and glory, while Pal signifies protector or supporter. Thus, Yashpal is one who protects and upholds righteousness, bringing fame and glory to God.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word याश् (Yash), which means 'light' or 'radiance'. The suffix पल (pal) means 'to grow' or 'to flourish', hence the name Yashpal means 'one who grows in light' or 'one who flourishes in radiance'.

historical_references.reference: Yashpal was a renowned poet and scholar in medieval India. He was born in 1281 AD in the town of Multan in present-day Pakistan. Yashpal wrote in the language of Braj, a dialect of Hindi spoken in the region of Braj in northern India, and his most famous work is the 'Bhay-Bhajan', a collection of devotional songs dedicated to the Hindu god Krishna.

Yashpal was also a prominent Rajput warrior in the 17th century AD. He was the ruler of the small princely state of Jodhpur in Rajasthan, India. Yashpal is best known for his military campaigns against the Mughal Empire and his efforts to expand the borders of his state.
